purpose.source_sha256: Limit this normalization recipe to the inspected Meshy 6 Lite wolf export.
purpose.yaw_degrees: Raw Blender inspection shows the nose points -Y; rotate it to the existing +Y-front review convention.
purpose.target_height_metres: The crouched candidate's highest point is its withers/fur ridge. Uniformly set that height to the concept's proposed 1.05 metres, then ground and centre it. This does not change gameplay size.
purpose.face_area_epsilon: Flag effectively zero-area triangles in source units for inspection; never silently remove them.
purpose.smooth_shading: Correct the export's flat face shading on the review copy without moving any vertices or hiding silhouette defects.
purpose.sharp_edge_angle_degrees: Keep normal discontinuities at folds sharper than this angle so smoothing does not erase plate edges.
purpose.extra_views: Supplement the unchanged baseline cameras with a close view of the lowered head and a floor-free underside inspection. These are explicitly not matched comparison views.
